exposure: Women at 41-42 weeks gestation with intrapartum fetal monitor category 2-3 vs. category 1
cohort: 101 women with low-risk singleton pregnancies at 40-42 weeks gestation with normal amniotic fluid index, who delivered in a university affiliated hospital from 2020-2021
finding: In women with postdate pregnancies (40-42 weeks) and normal amniotic fluid, fetal Doppler indices, including the cerebroplacental ratio, were not predictive of adverse pregnancy outcomes.
